fact_text: A simple moving average is the average of the previous 50 closing prices, and on a chart it often acts as support or resistance.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '7. What is Moving Average Indicator? How to Use It to Trade Successfully in the PSX' (YouTube, 2024-10-01)

fact_text: An exponential moving average reacts faster to price than a simple moving average, and the analyst prefers it because price respects it more.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '7. What is Moving Average Indicator? How to Use It to Trade Successfully in the PSX' (YouTube, 2024-10-01)

fact_text: The analyst said a trade can be taken when price returns to a moving average and is confirmed by the chart.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '7. What is Moving Average Indicator? How to Use It to Trade Successfully in the PSX' (YouTube, 2024-10-01)
